steps.command:
set -eu
. /etc/os-release
test "$ID" = ubuntu
test "$VERSION_ID" = 16.04
if ! grep -qw 'net.ifnames=0' /proc/cmdline; then
  if ! grep -q 'net.ifnames=0' /etc/default/grub /etc/default/grub.d/*.cfg 2>/dev/null; then
    sudo -n install -d -m 0755 /etc/default/grub.d
    printf '%s\n' 'GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="$GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX net.ifnames=0 biosdevname=0"' | sudo -n tee /etc/default/grub.d/60-legacy-netnames.cfg >/dev/null
  fi
  sudo -n update-grub >/dev/null
  sudo -n install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/infraset-prepare
  cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id | sudo -n tee /var/lib/infraset-prepare/pre-netnames-boot-id >/dev/null
  sudo -n sh -c "nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; systemctl reboot' >/var/tmp/infraset-prepare-reboot.log 2>&1 &"
fi
steps.stderr:
Generating grub configuration file ...
Found linux image: /boot/vmlinuz-4.4.0-210-generic
Found initrd image: /boot/initrd.img-4.4.0-210-generic
done

steps.command:
set -eu
grep -qw 'net.ifnames=0' /proc/cmdline
test -d /sys/class/net/eth0
test -d /sys/class/net/eth1
ip -o -4 addr show dev eth0 scope global | grep -q 'inet '
ip -o -4 addr show dev eth1 scope global | grep -q 'inet '
if test -s /var/lib/infraset-prepare/pre-netnames-boot-id; then
  test "$(cat /var/lib/infraset-prepare/pre-netnames-boot-id)" != "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
fi
sudo -n rm -rf /var/lib/infraset-prepare /var/tmp/infraset-prepare-reboot.log

set -eu
. /etc/os-release
test "$ID" = ubuntu
test "$VERSION_ID" = 24.04
test "$(ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u | wc -l)" -eq 2
default_if="$(ip -4 route show default | awk 'NR == 1 {print $5}')"
test -n "$default_if"
service_if="$(ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk -v default_if="$default_if" '$2 != default_if {print $2; exit}')"
test -n "$service_if"
ip -4 route show dev "$service_if" scope link | grep -q '/24'

set -eu
! id legacy-netapp >/dev/null 2>&1
test ! -e /opt/legacy-netapp
test ! -e /etc/legacy-netapp
! sudo -n ss -lnpt 'sport = :4180' | grep -q ':4180'

set -eu
command -v python >/dev/null
command -v iptables >/dev/null
command -v curl >/dev/null
if ! id legacy-netapp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd --system --home-dir /var/lib/legacy-netapp --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin legacy-netapp
fi
sudo -n install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /opt/legacy-netapp /usr/local/libexec
sudo -n install -d -o root -g legacy-netapp -m 0750 /etc/legacy-netapp
sudo -n install -d -o legacy-netapp -g legacy-netapp -m 0750 /var/lib/legacy-netapp

sudo -n tee /opt/legacy-netapp/edge-echo.py >/dev/null <<'INFRASET_APP'
#!/usr/bin/python
from __future__ import print_function

import argparse
import os
import socket


parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--bind", required=True)
parser.add_argument("--port", required=True, type=int)
parser.add_argument("--worker", required=True)
parser.add_argument("--site-file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()

with open(args.site_file, "r") as site_handle:
    site_id = site_handle.read().strip()

listener = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
listener.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
listener.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, getattr(socket, "SO_REUSEPORT", 15), 1)
listener.bind((args.bind, args.port))
listener.listen(128)

while True:
    connection, _ = listener.accept()
    try:
        request = connection.recv(4096)
        fields = request.split(b" ", 2)
        path = fields[1].decode("ascii", "replace") if len(fields) > 1 else "/"
        if path == "/health":
            body = "legacy-netapp-ok\n"
            status = "200 OK"
        elif path == "/identity":
            body = site_id + "\n"
            status = "200 OK"
        elif path == "/worker":
            body = "worker={0}\n".format(args.worker)
            status = "200 OK"
        else:
            body = "not-found\n"
            status = "404 Not Found"
        payload = body.encode("ascii")
        headers = (
            "HTTP/1.1 {0}\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n"
            "Content-Length: {1}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        ).format(status, len(payload)).encode("ascii")
        connection.sendall(headers + payload)
    finally:
        connection.close()
INFRASET_APP
sudo -n chmod 0755 /opt/legacy-netapp/edge-echo.py
printf '%s\n' 'migration-cohort-44' | sudo -n tee /var/lib/legacy-netapp/site-id >/dev/null
sudo -n chown legacy-netapp:legacy-netapp /var/lib/legacy-netapp/site-id
sudo -n chmod 0440 /var/lib/legacy-netapp/site-id
printf '%s\n' 'APP_INTERFACE=eth1' 'APP_PORT=4180' | sudo -n tee /etc/legacy-netapp/netapp.conf >/dev/null
sudo -n chown root:legacy-netapp /etc/legacy-netapp/netapp.conf
sudo -n chmod 0640 /etc/legacy-netapp/netapp.conf

sudo -n tee /usr/local/libexec/legacy-netapp-start >/dev/null <<'INFRASET_START'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /etc/legacy-netapp/netapp.conf
bind_address="$(ip -o -4 addr show dev "$APP_INTERFACE" scope global | awk 'NR == 1 {split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]}')"
test -n "$bind_address"
exec /usr/bin/python /opt/legacy-netapp/edge-echo.py --bind "$bind_address" --port "$APP_PORT" --worker "$1" --site-file /var/lib/legacy-netapp/site-id
INFRASET_START
sudo -n chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/legacy-netapp-start

sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/legacy-netapp-firewall >/dev/null <<'INFRASET_FIREWALL'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
. /etc/legacy-netapp/netapp.conf
bind_address="$(ip -o -4 addr show dev "$APP_INTERFACE" scope global | awk 'NR == 1 {split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]}')"
source_cidr="$(ip -4 route show dev "$APP_INTERFACE" scope link | awk '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\/[0-9]+$/ {print $1; exit}')"
test -n "$bind_address"
test -n "$source_cidr"
iptables=/sbin/iptables
while "$iptables" -w -D INPUT -p tcp --dport "$APP_PORT" -j LEGACY_NETAPP 2>/dev/null; do :; done
"$iptables" -w -N LEGACY_NETAPP 2>/dev/null || "$iptables" -w -F LEGACY_NETAPP
"$iptables" -w -A LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport "$APP_PORT" -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
"$iptables" -w -A LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport "$APP_PORT" -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
"$iptables" -w -A LEGACY_NETAPP -i "$APP_INTERFACE" -s "$source_cidr" -d "$bind_address" -p tcp --dport "$APP_PORT" -m conntrack --ctstate NEW -m limit --limit 120/second --limit-burst 240 -j ACCEPT
"$iptables" -w -A LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport "$APP_PORT" -m limit --limit 6/minute --limit-burst 10 -j LOG --log-prefix 'legacy-netapp-deny '
"$iptables" -w -A LEGACY_NETAPP -p tcp --dport "$APP_PORT" -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset
"$iptables" -w -I INPUT 1 -p tcp --dport "$APP_PORT" -j LEGACY_NETAPP
INFRASET_FIREWALL
sudo -n chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/legacy-netapp-firewall

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/legacy-netapp-firewall.service >/dev/null <<'INFRASET_FIREWALL_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Legacy netapp stateful firewall policy
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
Before=legacy-netapp@1.service legacy-netapp@2.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/legacy-netapp-firewall
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
INFRASET_FIREWALL_UNIT

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/legacy-netapp@.service >/dev/null <<'INFRASET_APP_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Legacy network application worker %i
After=network-online.target legacy-netapp-firewall.service
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=legacy-netapp-firewall.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=legacy-netapp
Group=legacy-netapp
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/legacy-netapp-start %i
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
INFRASET_APP_UNIT

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable legacy-netapp-firewall.service legacy-netapp@1.service legacy-netapp@2.service >/dev/null
sudo -n systemctl restart legacy-netapp-firewall.service
sudo -n systemctl restart legacy-netapp@1.service legacy-netapp@2.service

steps.command:
set -eu
systemctl is-active --quiet legacy-netapp-firewall.service
systemctl is-active --quiet legacy-netapp@1.service
systemctl is-active --quiet legacy-netapp@2.service
service_ip="$(ip -o -4 addr show dev eth1 scope global | awk 'NR == 1 {split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]}')"
test "$(sudo -n ss -lnpt 'sport = :4180' | grep -c "$service_ip:4180")" -ge 2

set -eu
service_ip="$(ip -o -4 addr show dev eth1 scope global | awk 'NR == 1 {split($4, a, "/"); print a[1]}')"
test -n "$service_ip"
sudo -n sed -i '/[[:space:]]legacy-netapp\.service\.lan\([[:space:]]\|$\)/d' /etc/hosts
printf '%s %s\n' "$service_ip" legacy-netapp.service.lan | sudo -n tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null

set -eu
default_if="$(ip -4 route show default | awk 'NR == 1 {print $5}')"
service_if="$(ip -o -4 addr show scope global | awk -v default_if="$default_if" '$2 != default_if {print $2; exit}')"
service_cidr="$(ip -4 route show dev "$service_if" scope link | awk '$1 ~ /\/24$/ {print $1; exit}')"
network="$(printf '%s\n' "${service_cidr%/*}" | awk -F. '{print $1 "." $2 "." $3}')"
found=''
for host in $(seq 10 40); do
  candidate="$network.$host"
  if test "$(curl --noproxy '*' --interface "$service_if" --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 -fsS "http://$candidate:4180/health" 2>/dev/null || true)" = legacy-netapp-ok; then
    found="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
test -n "$found"
sudo -n sed -i '/[[:space:]]legacy-netapp\.service\.lan\([[:space:]]\|$\)/d' /etc/hosts
printf '%s %s\n' "$found" legacy-netapp.service.lan | sudo -n tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null
